performance_informed_diagnosis: The v3 result revealed excessive membership-driven turnover.
The equal-weight composite's SIZE component conflicts structurally with an explicit size-neutral portfolio.
All data through 2024 have already been inspected; this experiment cannot create a pristine holdout.

locked_signal_design.exclusion_reason: SIZE is an explicit risk constraint, so it is excluded from the alpha forecast rather than added and then residualized away.
locked_signal_design.training_objective: mean monthly Spearman IC averaged uniformly across 1, 3, 6, and 12-month horizons
locked_signal_design.weight_rule: clip development mean IC at zero, normalize, then shrink 50% toward equal weights

locked_portfolio_design.holding_buffer: existing positions are explicitly carried into the next point-in-time risk pool and remain eligible through absolute residual-score rank 500; new entries require rank 200 or better
locked_portfolio_design.capacity_limit: absolute position <= min(2%, 10% of lagged median ADV / $100m)
locked_portfolio_design.optimizer_parameter_source: unchanged from the pre-2020-selected v3 assertive candidate

locked_cost_model.spread: lagged CRSP closing bid/ask with the unchanged conservative fallback and two-basis-point floor
locked_cost_model.market_impact: 0.10 times daily volatility times square root of trade dollars over median ADV

locked_reporting.sharpe: monthly net returns annualized by square-root of 12
locked_reporting.ic: monthly Spearman rank IC at 1, 3, 6, and 12 months
locked_reporting.icir: mean monthly rank IC divided by monthly rank-IC standard deviation
locked_reporting.factor_residual_information_ratio: annualized FF5+momentum regression intercept divided by annualized residual volatility
locked_reporting.benchmark_relative_ir: retained for transparency but not used as the main IR for a dollar-neutral sleeve

acceptance_gates: primary net Sharpe exceeds both matched frozen baseline and v3
primary average turnover does not exceed the matched frozen baseline
temporal-assessment V4_SCORE IC exceeds COMPOSITE IC at the same horizon
factor-residual information ratio exceeds matched frozen baseline
all exposure, position, capacity, solver, and privacy checks pass
paired 12-month moving-block Sharpe interval versus baseline is reported regardless of outcome
amendment_policy: Only performance-uninformed feasibility amendments may occur before any v4 return or IC result is inspected. Every amendment must record the prior hash and reason.

amendment_history.reason: The constraint-only path stopped at 2010-03-31 because a rank-400 exit band forced 0.382081 of existing gross exposure out, leaving insufficient turnover capacity to restore the frozen neutralities under the 0.75 ceiling. No v4 forward return, IC, Sharpe, IR, or public result artifact had been computed or inspected.
amendment_history.change: Widen only the existing-holding retention band from absolute residual-score rank 400 to rank 500, which is the already-frozen risk-pool boundary. The rank-200 new-entry rule, 0.75 turnover ceiling, signal weights, costs, exposures, and optimizer parameters are unchanged.

amendment_history.reason: After widening the exit band, the constraint-only path reached 2011-11-30 and stopped because holdings were being removed by the raw risk-pool truncation before the residual-rank holding buffer was evaluated. That contradicted the frozen holding-buffer intent. No v4 forward return, IC, Sharpe, IR, or public result artifact had been computed or inspected.
amendment_history.change: Carry actual current holdings into the following month’s point-in-time risk pool before computing the residual-score exit rank. The rank-200 entry rule, rank-500 exit rule, 0.75 turnover ceiling, signal weights, costs, exposures, and optimizer parameters are unchanged.

claim_policy: This is an explicitly post-result retrospective follow-up. Better metrics, if observed, are exploratory evidence only and must never be described as validated alpha.
